notes.title: Update v1.4.0 patch notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We're alive! As we recently brought Dollhouse to... another PC store platform ;), we found that there were still some things in the game that needed fixing. That's why we're bringing a one-off new patch here to the game on Steam as well!

This update focuses on fixing some nasty bugs that were still in the game. Here's a full list!


Fixed an issue where the second track "The moon is blue" was not audible in the game after track is switched
Fixed an issue where button text overlapped
Fixed an issue where death mask item in mannequin augmented in the journal, had placeholder thumbnail
Fixed an issue where equipping one or two passive abilities did not complete the 'Equip 2 abilities' quest
Fixed an issue where after respawning the flash light charge level was not full
Fixed an issue where texts got cut off on different show timing boards due to wall texture in chapter 2
Fixed an issue where player was able to assign 'Windows' and 'Num Lock' keys in the Controls Key binding section
Fixed an issue where player fails to progress further if they stabbed bodies more than the required amount in Chapter 4
Fixed an issue where burst SFX was not audible after players analyzed any game asset
Fixed an issue where ability unnecessarily got triggered if player pressed 'RT' to use Flash during gameplay
Fixed an issue where players could not pick up extracted memory from Skill share station on Chapter 6
Fixed an issue where wall texture was missing at the door present in the lost room of the 3rd Chapter
Fixed an issue where the ability points were displayed in negative value during lost room of Chapter 4
Fixed an issue where the enlighten ability unlocked more than once after progressing

If you encounter any other issues since this patch, please don't hesitate to reach out through the Steam Community Hub!

-Marten

notes.title: [ROSE’S DIAGNOSTIC] REPORT #4 CURSES UPDATE & NEW QoL CHANGES
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5705637/32a9a7609eb4a60f377504855542e19eda1e8b88.jpg

Version 1.1.7

CURSES UPDATE


Each character has their own unique curse that affects players when they’ve been cut. Players will now need to plan strategically who they are cutting so they can adjust their playstyle and loadout accordingly to create a new way to engage each level. These curses range from reducing the amount charges that are spawned to make players play more conservatively to something drastic as losing their whole inventory. Cut Wisely.

GAMEPLAY UPDATE



 Fixed Issues making Dolls spawn in awkward scales
 Added a few new narrative lines in the Final Level to explain mechanics a better more clearly


QoL UPDATE



 Subtitle font sizes can be changed in the option menu
 Fixed Steam Controller splash in the options menu to properly display bindings
 Updated controller splash in the options menu for all controllers so it shows how to turn on/off the flashlight


SCRIPT EDITOR UPDATE



 When the player collected all fragments off the wall, the player would still have blanks in the Script so players will still need to engage in the script editor in the Dressing Room
 Added tutorial objectives in the Script Editor so it helps players understand it a bit more


MOVIE EDITOR UPDATE



 Updated submission screen to display what curse the player received from the person they Cut
 Updated the Movie Editor layout to tell the player who they're cutting when they are editing their movie
 Updated the Movie Editor layout so each element display who the memory is associated with, and which enhancements they'll get if they drop it into the timeline
 Updated how to play page to include a new section about curses
 Updated how to play pages with new graphics to accompany the new mechanics
 Added tutorial objectives in the Movie Editor so it helps players understand it a bit more


ENHANCEMENT CARDS SCREEN UPDATE



 Minor edits to the page where Enhancement Cards are given so it's less empty
 Updated the Enhancement Cards so it's showing more information


REVIEW SCREEN UPDATE



 Shows how much each player got in each category instead of making players guess


CUTSCENE UPDATE



 Fixed a case where a certain character model’s head was not rendering in a certain cutscene
 Fixed issues where a certain character model's dress is being more emissive than normal
 Fixed a few lighting issues in the cutscenes making some scenes too dark or too light on default settings


MULTIPLAYER UPDATE



 Fixed residual edge cases that MP Death screen wasn't catching the numbers before it was cleared by the host resulting in the incorrect number display
 Updated more various MP messages with new text
 Increased the duration of the spinning reel animation at the end of the match to account for MP Death Screen overlaps
 Made the end match reel slightly thinner to make it look nicer

notes.title: [IMPORTANT] CRITICAL BUG FIXES ON THE WAY
notes.notes:
To our community,

There were a few game breaking bugs that slipped through the cracks before it was launched and we will be resolving these issues ASAP hopefully be live by tomorrow latest. 

The following is a list of known issues that we will be tackling:

1. A RARE progression bug stopping players from completing the game at later levels
2. World going dark without resuming normal lighting after using a Memory Station
3. Mannequins don’t seem to attack/ less lethal at later levels
4. Adding a Missing Memory Count in the HUD
5. Align the Death Screen text & make it more obvious to the player what they lost

By Monday, we plan to fix a lot of the display issues wrong in Multiplayer and the inability to Focus properly.

We also plan to unveil an Official Milestone List of our internal plans early next week of the issues we will be tackling based on your honest feedback.

We’ve spent a long time working on Dollhouse and we DO NOT plan to let it go unfixed.

QA is not a perfect process, and as a team of just 12 members we are constantly working hard to bring our community the best version of Dollhouse possible. 

Please join the Soedesco Discord and visit the Dollhouse channel, or visit our Community on Steam to report any bugs you have encountered. This is the fastest method to get the reports directly to our team. 

-Creazn Studio

notes.title: Dollhouse Open Beta patch notes #1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

You might've noticed that we issued a patch for Dollhouse! The most important fix is that we've partially fixed the multiplayer in the beta. We isolated the issues with the multiplayer connection issues with some players. We will need a few more days at most to completely resolve the issue. Multiplayer may work for some players now, but it is only a partial fix. We hope to have it live by this weekend so you can stab each other in the back :)

Multiplayer

Fixed infinite loading screen issue before the match starts

Singleplayer

Implemented better lighting on death
Implemented additional death animations
Implemented additional mannequin attack animations
Fixed trap launching player into space issue
Fixed bug where Focus audio loop continues playback on level unload
Fixed bug where Focus scanning removes charge when kicked
Fixed bug where monster taunt is cutoff when kicked from scanning

Health & Quality of Life Changes

HUD in options displayed properly
Objective marker in tutorial displays objective properly

We're still working on fixing the multiplayer before the weekend, so please bear with us :D

In the meantime, if you want a good laugh, check out DashieGames' playthrough of Dollhouse: https://youtu.be/JVzE2wo30Ao

notes.title: Dollhouse schedules scares for May release date
notes.notes:
Film noir horror game Dollhouse is launching on May 24th, and they’ve put out a new trailer to celebrate. I made the mistake of watching said trailer last night, after dark, while home alone. I do not recommend this for the faint of heart. It has all the things you need from a horror game: giggling children and muted colours and warped children   s lullabies. And jump scares. Lots of jump scares. If it’s still light out where you are, or you’re braver than I am, take a peek through your fingers.
 (more…)

notes.title: SOEDESCO takes on publishing of Dollhouse, developer update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
 
It's Andrew here, project manager at Creazn Studio, developer of Dollhouse. It's been quite some time since we talked with you guys and I want to apologize for that. Today I've got great news which is best explained by video:

https://youtu.be/z6ImoHanpWw
Now, publisher SOEDESCO was already taking care of the physical publishing of Dollhouse, but now they'll also help us out with the digital side of publishing. This allows us to focus more on development and give a clearer timeline as to when things will be done.
 
Keep an eye on Dollhouse, because we'll have more updates for you soon!

-Andrew
